label: Governance & Process
description: Focuses on governance structures, accountability, transparency, decision-making, process efficiency, and standardization efforts.

label: Community & Collaboration
description: Centers on community engagement, collaboration, feedback mechanisms, and contribution practices.

label: Documentation Standards
description: Ensures documentation is accessible, accurate, clear, consistent, and up-to-date, including commit message standards.

label: Implementation Practices
description: Addresses clarity, complexity, consistency, and flexibility in the implementation of code or systems.

label: Specification Practices
description: Covers clarity, completeness, compliance, and consistency of technical specifications.

label: Protocol Standards
description: Deals with protocol compliance, evolution, extensibility, flexibility, implementation, and interoperability.

label: Quality Assurance
description: Encompasses quality assurance practices, code quality, testing, error handling, backward compatibility, scalability, and security.

label: Project & Repository Management
description: Manages project dependencies and repository structure and maintenance.
